contract: contract.md; Mochi companion frontend. Browser adapters verify UI behavior only; native OS tests and screenshots are separate.

accessibility.evidence: axe WCAG 2 A/AA and WCAG 2.1 AA found zero violations on mobile empty, desktop active and denied-permission views. Keyboard Enter toggles modes, focus outline is visible, reduced motion is enabled, controls use at least 44px CSS minimum height.

responsive.evidence: Rendered 390x844 and 1440x900; 320px supplemental check found no horizontal overflow. Long rejection text wraps without markup execution.

loading.evidence: Delayed IPC disables controls with a stable scene and busy action label.

empty.evidence: No activity offers one clear start action with diagnostics collapsed.

error.evidence: Long native rejection renders safely as text and restores the start control.

partial.evidence: Unknown OS state retains ownership with explicit pending copy; desktop unsupported cannot start.

success.evidence: Snack reaches 100%, offers completion, then resets; nap snooze retains start and adds exactly one minute.

permission.evidence: No prompt without a click; Android requests notifications and iOS checks liveActivities. Permission panel clears after a granted response.

renderedEvidence.observation: Cream and sage scene with a clear start action; diagnostics remain collapsed. Browser IPC adapter only.
Nap state changes the cat eyes and timer; a foreground countdown does not send periodic native updates. Browser adapter only.
Wide layout places the compact illustration beside the delivery state. Native surface visibility is described conditionally. Browser adapter only.
At 320px the labels and primary action remain within the viewport without horizontal scrolling.
Busy state retains the illustration and action position while disabling interactions.
Denied Android permission explains the Settings action and requires an explicit user gesture.
Accepted activity with unknown OS state retains its handle and reports observation pending, not visibility.
Long native rejection wraps as plain text without interpreting markup; the start control becomes available again.

checks: Mobile empty state: clear start, collapsed diagnostics, no overflow
Keyboard focus is visible and scenario toggle works with Enter
Nap start, snooze, scenario switching and finish preserve correct handles
Snack advances through packing, delivery and completion; terminal action resets
Lifecycle runner remains opt-in and preserves all 13 checks
Narrow 320px layout has no horizontal overflow
A successful receipt survives a failed refresh and mode switching
Loading keeps scene stable and disables mutable controls
Permission is explicit; no automatic request; Android action requests notifications
Unknown permission after cancellation stays explicitly retryable
iOS permission action checks Live Activities settings
Pending native observation keeps ownership and does not claim visibility
Long native error stays plain text and start can be retried
Unsupported desktop is explicit and cannot start a pretend activity
